address: 267/1 Mu 2, Mahidol Road, Pa Daet, Mueang Chiang Mai, Chiang Mai, 50100, Thailand
bio: This popular open-air eatery serves well-sized northern Thai favourites at fair prices. Kang Liang, the peppery curry paste in spicy mixed vegetables goes well with the prawns’ natural sweetness; while the local fish marinated in herbs and spices is grilled in a bamboo tube until soft, with a smoky aroma. Do check the blackboard for specials of the day, which often focus on seasonal dishes....
